name: 42420 · Henderson, KY
findings: ZIP 42420 (Henderson) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 42420 (Henderson) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 42420 (Henderson) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
